capabilities: Build mindmaps by dragging nodes to reparent or connecting ports between notes
Switch between five layout modes including tree, git-branch swim-lane, and force-directed network
Filter and multi-select nodes by type, status, or search for bulk move, delete, and modify
View dashboard statistics and a creation-time timeline for linked notes
Export maps as SVG, PNG, Markdown outline, or Obsidian Canvas
disambiguation: Not a freeform drawing tool; nodes are existing Markdown notes and drag actions write parent/children fields back to frontmatter.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; documentation is provided in both Chinese and English.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only displays link relationships read-only, so users cannot visually restructure note hierarchies or create parent/child connections by dragging.

relations.evidence: Excalidraw support: create/convert .excalidraw.md notes, preview as embed

summary: Visual mindmap plugin where each node is a Markdown note; drag to build parent/child links that auto-update note frontmatter.
